Al-Biruni translated Euclid's works into Sanskrit and Sanskrit works on grammar into Arabic."

items.answer: (i) The term Al-Biruni noted Brahmanas used for outsiders, whom they regarded as impure. items.stem:
Read the following extract on women, slaves, sati and labourers in travellers' accounts and answer the questions that follow.
"Ibn Battuta's account suggests considerable differentiation among slaves. European travellers treated the plight of women as a crucial marker of difference between Western and Eastern societies. Bernier described sati as a practice in which some women embraced death cheerfully while others were forced."

items.stem:
Read the following extract on François Bernier's account of the Mughal empire and answer the questions that follow.
"Bernier argued that because land was owned by the crown, landholders could not pass it on to their children and so did not invest in it. Bernier constantly compared Mughal India with contemporary Europe, generally emphasising the superiority of the latter. Bernier's descriptions influenced Western theorists such as Montesquieu and Karl Marx."

(iii) Explain the reason behind the following: Bernier's account became influential in Europe. (2)
items.answer: (i) Montesquieu (ii) Karl Marx's idea, influenced by Bernier, that the state appropriated the surplus of autonomous village communities in India. (iii) It was widely read, translated into English, Dutch, German and Italian, and used by thinkers such as Montesquieu and Marx.
